counter_scope: Foreground native attempts are observed on the caller thread. Primary means outside explicit maintenance scopes, not uniquely the owning Data commit; first_policy is the first observed native attempt. Maintenance barrier attempts count local-sync/cloud-strict calls within maintenance scopes. Engine-wide sync deltas may include background work and omit unaccounted filesystem syncs. wal_accounted_syncs already includes successful WAL fsync and ledger file/directory syncs; fields are retained separately, never added together. Clean reopen is not crash, power-loss or cloud-loss qualification.
timing_scope: Local diagnostic measurements on an uncontrolled macOS host; no production speedup or timing-quality threshold asserted.
